description: This file defines the server-side code-behind logic for the UserProfile web page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It handles loading user profile data from a database upon page load, manages navigation between pages via button click events, and checks for user session authentication.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for the UserProfile page, managing user data display and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial page load; retrieves and displays user information if the session exists, otherwise redirects to the login page.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to refresh or stay on the user profile page; currently commented out.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the leaderboard page.

methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.
